text:
Carmen: Quick sync after design review: noticed inconsistencies between the in-console docs panel and the docs site about nomenclature for 'Routes' vs 'Endpoints'. In-panel we show 'Routes' but site uses 'Endpoints'. This causes confusion in support tickets. Ethan: Oof. We should standardize. My vote is to use 'Route' in the console (short) and 'Endpoint' in the detailed docs, but we need to make the relationship explicit in the panel. Noah: Can we add a one-line clarifier under the panel heading that reads: 'Routes (see docs: Endpoints)' and link to /docs/console/routes?source=panel Clarifies both terms. Sofia: Accessibility & copy: the link text should be explicit: 'Read about Endpoints in full docs (opens in new tab)'. Also ensure link has title attr and aria-description for screen readers. Diego: Dev notes: - make panel header 'Routes' - under header add

Routes — see "Endpoints" in full docs

with link target=_blank rel=noopener - add analytics param source=panel_endpoint_link Carmen: Also add a tiny tooltip on hover for the term 'Endpoints' that shows the one-line definition. Could reuse the tooltip component. Ethan: UX idea: if the user is on the docs site and has the console open, add an in-docs banner 'Using an older term? In console this is called Routes' when visiting /docs/console/routes. Might be overkill for now. Noah: Tests: add a unit test verifying the panel includes the clarifier text and that the link includes ?source=panel_endpoint_link. Also an e2e that clicks the link and asserts it opened a new tab (mock). Sofia: Accessibility test: screenreader should read the clarifier as 'Routes, see Endpoints full docs, opens in new tab'. Diego: I'll implement and PR. Branch: feature/panel-routes-endpoints-clarify. Carmen: Please add a changelog entry and link to the design decision doc. We want support to reference the change when triaging tickets. Ethan: Adding to release notes draft. Noah: I'll help with the unit tests and QA. Sofia: I'll review accessibility copy and run a voiceover pass. Diego: Thanks all. I'll ping when PR ready for review.
